introHtml: Choosing a 1 2 inch wide product is ideal for compact promotional items that fit easily in pockets, bags, or as part of a larger gift set. This narrow width works well for custom printed keychains, silicone wristbands, or mini flashlights, offering a subtle but effective branding opportunity. For trade shows or event giveaways, these small items are cost-effective and easy to distribute in high volumes.
